item_or_substance: Pork lard (salo, CN 1501 00), meat, sausages, dairy products
key_exception_or_penalty: Exception <=2 kg sealed baby or medical food only; confiscation and fine at EU border

item_or_substance: Apples, potatoes, fresh vegetables and most fresh fruits
key_exception_or_penalty: Only 5 tropical fruits exempt: bananas, pineapples, coconuts, dates, durians

item_or_substance: Gutted fish; honey and eggs; bread, chocolate, coffee (no meat/dairy)
allowed_limit_bus_land_border: Fish <=20 kg; honey/eggs <=2 kg; shelf-stable goods up to 300 EUR
key_exception_or_penalty: Must contain zero meat or dairy ingredients; commercial quantities prohibited

allowed_limit_bus_land_border: 40 cigarettes (2 packs) OR 20 cigarillos OR 10 cigars OR 50 g tobacco
legal_basis: Ustawa o podatku akcyzowym Art. 36(1)(5); podatki.gov.pl
key_exception_or_penalty: Land border bus limit is 40 cigarettes (NOT 200 air limit); excess confiscated + fine

item_or_substance: E-cigarette liquid and heated tobacco sticks (IQOS/glo)
allowed_limit_bus_land_border: 10 ml e-liquid; 8 g (0.008 kg) heated tobacco
legal_basis: Ustawa o podatku akcyzowym Art. 36(1)(5); podatki.gov.pl
key_exception_or_penalty: Standard 20-stick heat-not-burn packs must stay within the 8 g tobacco weight limit

allowed_limit_bus_land_border: 1 L >22% ABV OR 2 L <=22% ABV, plus 4 L still wine and 16 L beer
legal_basis: Ustawa o podatku akcyzowym Art. 36(1)(5); podatki.gov.pl
key_exception_or_penalty: Applies per adult passenger aged 17+ for personal consumption only

allowed_limit_bus_land_border: Up to 5 smallest factory-sealed retail packages
key_exception_or_penalty: Original packaging required; no loose blisters without box/leaflet

allowed_limit_bus_land_border: Prohibited under the 5-pack rule without GIF permit
key_exception_or_penalty: Requires Polish Chief Pharmaceutical Inspector (GIF) permit or notarized medical records; criminal liability risk

item_or_substance: Cash declaration; powerbanks for flight connections; PL->UA imports
allowed_limit_bus_land_border: Cash >=10000 EUR must be declared; powerbanks <=100 Wh cabin only; PL->UA food <=200 EUR (<=2 kg/item), goods <=500 EUR and <=50 kg
key_exception_or_penalty: Bank withdrawal certificate <=90 days required when exiting Ukraine with >=10000 EUR

item_or_substance: Dogs, cats, ferrets traveling by international coach
allowed_limit_bus_land_border: Microchip + rabies vaccine + vet passport + rabies antibody titer >=0.5 IU/ml + 3-month wait
key_exception_or_penalty: Wartime exemptions ended 2023-07-01; rigid carrier (5-10 kg) and separate bus seat subject to carrier approval
